oscillatory_review.convention: Sampled native rho=B+M. A site must first be observed above high before opening below low; reformation requires an observed opening. Thresholds are concentration fractions of declared solid capacity, not mechanical cavities or organisms. Radial spectra sum fluctuation power in rounded physical wave-number shells; high-frequency fraction uses .7 of the smallest axis Nyquist.

frozen_dispersion.convention: Freeze N=.6, B at listed value, M=x=y=q=0 and paid fraction1. Actual B/N/M/work/reserve dynamics are omitted; the frozen state need not be an equilibrium. Inhibition and excitation use their actual physical diffusivities and discrete axis/diagonal stencil symbols. A stable zero mode and growing finite mode motivate a separate nonlinear test, not a material organization or convergence claim.

provenance.fixture: Dense randomized3D with mixed B/M occupancy, zero precursor/reserve donors, six full mixed-species neighbors competing for one empty center and anisotropic physical spacing.

numerical_gate_cpu_plumbing.interpretation: Numerical parity, material/capacity budget, recording and exact same-backend continuation only. CPU plumbing is not an accelerator result; this does not establish morphology or biological behavior.
